about_the_game:
Suburban rivalries have gone way too far!

Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is a chaotic multiplayer party brawler built for loud matches, funny moments, and shared laughter with friends, where home improvements meets home destruction. Team up in up to 5v5  matches, pick your favorite neighborhood menace, fortify your house, and storm your rivals’ lawn using everyday household items turned weapons.

Meet the Neighbors

Every neighborhood has those people

Pick from a cast of iconic suburban residents, from crafty homemakers, bratty kids, to grumpy retirees, each with their own unique playstyle, and abilities:

  • Doreen, the sweet granny sporting some sick boxing gloves

  • Kevin, the neighborhood menace armed with his trusty slingshot

  • And many more characters, all ready to throw down in the backyard

Mix and match characters to create crazy team combos and outplay your rivals.

Attack Your Neighbor

Turns out, the best defense really is a good offense.

Grab whatever you can find: frying pans, golf clubs, tomatoes and jump straight into the fight. Unlock and upgrade your gadgets, like the Seagull-130 Control Unit, capable of raining eggs and bird poop from above.

Defend Your House

Your fence won’t hold forever.

Reinforce windows, lay traps, and deploy clever defensive contraptions to keep enemy neighbors from smashing your precious household essentials. A well-defended home can buy you time while you're destroying theirs.

Unlock customizations

Flex on your neighbors with style.

Customize your neighbors with different outfits and weapon skins. Choose your own house, from cozy cabins to over the top mansions. Each house layout changes how matches play out, creating new strategies and chaotic gameplay.

Game modes

Things escalate quickly in this neighborhood. Sometimes into brawls, sometimes into robot invasions. Play with your friends across multiple different game modes:

Destruction: Smash the enemy house before they wreck yours.

Brawl: No houses, no rules, just pure fighting, knock out the enemy to win.

Prop hunt: Think chair. Be the chair! Hide as everyday objects or hunt down that sus couch.

Robot Invasion: Team up in this PvE mode and defend your house against waves of invading robots.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 4130, AMD FX-4150
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
